title: Art, History, and Tacos in Singapore
excerpt: A burnt-out rest day turned into an unexpected delight — a free visit to the National Gallery, an accidental guided tour, and the best (and priciest) tacos I had all trip.

photos.alt: White architectural scale model of the former Supreme Court and City Hall buildings displayed in a glass case at the National Gallery Singapore
Two fish tacos on corn tortillas topped with shredded cabbage slaw and fresh pico de gallo, served on a black plate
